name: Ketsugou Danshi -Elements with Emotions-
source:
In Ketsugou Danshi, players will guide those who possess the power of chemical elements—known as "Shikenkan"—to stop the world from being destroyed in 50 days through chemical bonding. The player takes on the role of a mediator who will bring together the Shikenkan who posses the power of each element. By combining them, the player will create various chemical reactions and fight against the enemy force known as  "Red Matter. "

[Taken from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/09/square-enix-announces-simulation-adventure-game-ketsugou-danshi-elements-with-emotions-for-switch-ios-android]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
在《结乡男子》中，玩家将引导那些拥有化学元素力量（被称为“Shikenkan”）的人通过化学键在50天内阻止世界被毁灭。玩家扮演调停者的角色，将拥有各元素力量的Shikenkan聚集在一起。通过将它们结合起来，玩家将产生各种化学反应，并与被称为“红色物质”的敌方力量进行战斗。

[摘自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/09/square-enix-announces-simulation-adventure-game-ketsugou-danshi-elements-with-emotions-for-switch-ios-android]Gematsu[/url]]
